app.title: Textida Setup
lang.label: Language
welcome.title: Welcome to Textida
welcome.intro: This setup installs Textida {version} for your user account. It needs no administrator rights and does not change other programs.
welcome.installed: Textida {installed} is installed in {dir}. This setup updates it to {version} and keeps your settings.
licence.title: Licence
options.title: Options
options.menu: Entry “{label}” in the Explorer context menu
options.assoc: Offer Textida under Open with for these file types
options.dirNotEmpty: {dir} holds files that do not belong to Textida. Choose another folder.
done.updated: Textida was updated to {version} in {dir}. The previous version is kept in {previous}.
done.switched: Textida {version} is now in {dir}; the previous version is kept in {previous}.
error.title: The setup did not finish
error.running: Textida is running. Close it and try again.
error.badPackage: This setup holds no complete Textida package.
error.unknownDir: {detail} exists and is not a Textida folder. Nothing was changed.
error.notInstalled: Textida is not installed in {detail}. Nothing was changed.
error.noPrevious: There is no previous version in {detail}. Nothing was changed.
error.badStaging: {detail} is not a complete Textida package. Nothing was changed.
error.invalidDir: {detail} cannot be used as an install folder.
error.noPackage: This copy of the setup carries no program files. Download the full TextidaSetup.exe.
uninstall.title: Remove Textida
uninstall.question: Textida will be removed from {dir}, together with its shortcuts and the entries it added to Windows.
uninstall.done: Textida was removed. Your settings in {data} were kept.
uninstall.doneAll: Textida and its settings were removed.
